txs.description: Deploy FistagentMint via the CREATE2 deployer proxy (also deploys FistagentToken and creates the official, empty PancakeSwap FISTAGENT/USDT pair). Mint starts PAUSED; shares #1-#1,100 are burned (sale starts at #1,101). Before share 10,000: 20% of each payment to the treasury, 80% held by the mint contract; the tx reaching share 10,000 automatically opens the official pool with everything parked (7,120 USDT + 356B FISTAGENT), LP to dead. FISTAGENT change vs BNAGENT: after the pool opens, 100% of each mint payment goes to the treasury (no LP is added by mints).

Open minting: treasury calls setPaused(false) on the mint contract (only after the website shows the deployed addresses). The first unpause starts the 30-day clock: if share 10,000 is not reached by mintStartTime + 30 days, only the treasury can call withdrawUnfilled() (selector 0xa65c6326), which sends all USDT held to the treasury and the parked pool tokens to dead; minting continues and the call is repeatable until the pool opens.
